info.name: awesome_notifications_fcm (FCM v1)
info.description:
Sample pushes for the awesome_notifications_fcm example app.

Set `project_id`, `bearer_token` (an OAuth2 access token with the firebase.messaging scope) and `fcm_token` (printed by the example app).

Every message is data-only so the plugin builds the notification in any app state (on iOS it arrives as a background push; iOS throttles those and does not deliver them to a force-quit app). Images are pinned to a commit of the plugin repository so they never expire.
